app.name: Asset Studio
app.tagline: A local workbench for consistent AI-made visual assets.

search.note: Searching assets, styles and poses arrives with the library (WP-10).

engine.label: Engine status
engine.heldJobs: GPU jobs wait in the queue until the engine runs; you can still queue new ones.
engine.agentNotConfigured: The host agent is not set up, so the engine cannot be started from here. Run the setup script.
engine.agentDown: The host agent is not running on this computer. Start it with the start script.

session.failed: Asset Studio cannot reach its API
session.notConfigured: Asset Studio is not set up yet
session.hint: Start the stack with the start script, then try again.

settings.queueHint: While paused, running jobs finish and nothing new starts, except backup and restore.
settings.locationsHint: Folders are chosen in the .env file at setup (ADR-013) and take effect after a restart. The app never shows paths from your computer.
settings.backupHint: A backup holds the database, every library file and the list of models with their hashes and sources. Model files are not included.
settings.backupsNotConfigured: The backup folder is not configured. Set ASSET_STUDIO_BACKUPS_HOST_DIR in .env.
settings.noBackups: No backups in the backup folder yet.
settings.restoreNotEmpty: Restore works only into an empty data location (a fresh install). This one already has projects.
settings.mcpConfigured: The MCP token is set: Claude can connect.
settings.mcpNotConfigured: The MCP token is not set. Set ASSET_STUDIO_MCP_TOKEN in .env and restart.
settings.mcpToken: Replace <token> with ASSET_STUDIO_MCP_TOKEN from .env. The app never shows the token; to change it, edit .env and restart.
settings.mcpRules: Claude works through the same API as you: it cannot delete, download models or change settings, and it approves, rejects or publishes only in projects where you allow it.

problems.ENGINE_NOT_CONFIGURED: No ComfyUI folder is configured for the host agent. Run the setup script.
problems.ENGINE_NOT_INSTALLED: ComfyUI is not installed in the configured folder. Run the setup script.
problems.HOST_AGENT_UNAVAILABLE: The host agent is not running on this computer.
problems.HOST_AGENT_NOT_CONFIGURED: The host agent token is not set. Run the setup script.
problems.HOST_AGENT_REJECTED: The host agent rejected the token. Check that both use the same token.
problems.ACTOR_NOT_ALLOWED: Only you can do this, not Claude (MCP).
problems.STYLE_NAME_TAKEN: A style with this name already exists.
problems.CHARACTER_NAME_TAKEN: A character with this name already exists.

problems.IMAGE_SIZE_OUT_OF_RANGE: Each side must be between 64 and 8192 pixels.
problems.LINK_OTHER_PROJECT: The reference belongs to another project.
problems.POSE_TOO_FEW_JOINTS: A pose needs at least 4 visible joints.
problems.POSE_BUILTIN_READONLY: Built-in poses cannot be changed; save a copy.
problems.POSE_DETECTOR_NOT_INSTALLED: Pose detection models are not installed. Install them with the command in the setup guide.
problems.POSE_NOT_FOUND: No person was found. Draw a box around the figure and try again.
problems.REQUEST_INVALID: Some values are not valid. Check the fields and try again.
problems.POSE_MODEL_CORRUPT: A pose detection model file is damaged. Install the models again.
problems.DOWNLOAD_CONFIRMATION_MISMATCH: The catalogue entry changed. Reload and confirm again.
problems.DOWNLOAD_IN_PROGRESS: This model is already being downloaded.
problems.VERIFY_IN_PROGRESS: This model is already being checked.
problems.CHECKSUM_MISMATCH: The downloaded file did not match its checksum and was discarded.
problems.DOWNLOAD_FAILED: The download failed. Try again later.
problems.DOWNLOAD_INCOMPLETE: The download stopped early. Start it again to continue.
problems.LICENCE_NO_CONFLICT: This model's licence fits the project.
problems.MODEL_FROM_CATALOGUE: The catalogue sets this model's family.
problems.GENERATION_NOT_READY: The generation is not ready. Fix the problems in the checks.
problems.LICENCE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED: Confirm the model licence for this project in Models.
problems.REGENERATE_FIELD_FIXED: This field cannot change when regenerating.
problems.VERSION_NOT_GENERATED: This version was not generated here, so no settings are stored.
problems.VERSION_DELETED: The file of this version was deleted.
problems.CATEGORY_UNKNOWN: The category does not exist in the project.
problems.MODEL_KIND_WRONG: The chosen model has the wrong type.
problems.MODEL_NOT_FOUND: The model is not in the registry.
problems.GENERATION_OUTPUT_INVALID: The engine returned a file that is not an image.
problems.JOB_NOT_CANCELLABLE: This job can no longer be cancelled.
problems.JOB_LEASE_LOST: The worker lost the job; retry it.
problems.ASSET_OTHER_PROJECT: The asset belongs to another project.
problems.STYLE_OTHER_PROJECT: The style belongs to another project.
problems.CHARACTER_OTHER_PROJECT: The character belongs to another project.
problems.POSE_OTHER_PROJECT: The pose belongs to another project.
problems.REFERENCE_OTHER_PROJECT: The reference belongs to another project.
problems.VERSION_OTHER_PROJECT: The version belongs to another project.
problems.PROCESSING_MODEL_MISSING: Background removal needs a segmentation model (BiRefNet). Install it in Models.
problems.PROCESSING_NOT_ALLOWED: This version cannot be processed now.
problems.VERSION_NOT_PROCESSING: The version is no longer being processed.
problems.VERSION_NOT_PROCESSED: The version has no processed file yet.
problems.BACKGROUND_NOT_REMOVED: Background removal has not run for this version.
problems.IMAGE_TOO_LARGE: The image has too many pixels.
problems.MASK_INVALID: The engine returned an invalid mask.
problems.COLLECTION_EXISTS: A collection with this name already exists.
problems.COLLECTION_CHANGED: The collection changed meanwhile. Try again.
problems.TOO_MANY_TAGS: An asset can have at most 20 tags.
problems.COMMENT_TOO_LONG: A comment can have at most 4000 characters.
problems.LIFECYCLE_TRANSITION_NOT_ALLOWED: This action is not possible in the version's current state.
problems.MCP_NOT_ALLOWED: This project does not allow Claude to make decisions.
problems.OVERWRITE_NOT_CONFIRMED: Some files already exist in the target. Confirm each overwrite.

problems.PLAN_USED: This plan was already published. Plan again.
problems.PLAN_EXPIRED: The plan is too old. Plan again.
problems.PLAN_OTHER_ACTOR: The plan was made by someone else.
problems.PLAN_PATH_COLLISION: Two versions would write the same file. Change the naming or the choice.
problems.NOTHING_TO_PUBLISH: There is no approved version to publish.
problems.EXPORT_ROOT_UNKNOWN: Choose one of the configured export folders.
problems.EXPORT_ROOT_UNAVAILABLE: The target's export folder is not configured any more.
problems.TARGET_PATH_INVALID: The folder must stay inside the export folder.
problems.NAME_TAKEN: This name is already used in the project.
problems.NOT_APPROVED: The version is not approved any more.
problems.ARCHIVED: The preset or the target is archived.
problems.OTHER_PROJECT: The preset and the target must belong to the project.
problems.BACKUP_NAME_INVALID: This is not a backup name.
problems.BACKUP_NOT_FOUND: This backup is not in the backup folder.
problems.BACKUP_INVALID: This archive is not a valid Asset Studio backup.
problems.BACKUP_CORRUPT: The backup is damaged: a file does not match its checksum. Nothing was restored.
problems.BACKUP_SCHEMA_UNKNOWN: The backup comes from a newer version of Asset Studio. Update before restoring.
problems.DATA_LOCATION_NOT_EMPTY: Restore works only into an empty data location. This one already has projects.
problems.RESTORE_INCOMPLETE: Restored, but some version files are missing.
problems.CONFIG_BREAKING_CHANGE: The change can affect existing assets or exports. Confirm to continue.
problems.TRIGGER_WORD_INVALID: The trigger word is 2-40 lowercase letters, digits or _, starting with a letter.
problems.VERSION_NOT_APPROVED: Only approved or published versions can be used for training.
problems.DATASET_TOO_SMALL: A dataset needs at least 5 images.
problems.DATASET_FULL: A dataset holds at most 200 images.
problems.IMAGE_DUPLICATE: This image is already in the dataset.
problems.BASE_MODEL_INVALID: Choose an installed checkpoint of the chosen family.
problems.STEPS_OUT_OF_RANGE: The number of steps is outside the allowed range.
problems.TRAINING_ALREADY_QUEUED: A training run is already queued in this project.
problems.TRAINING_FAILED: Training failed. The log is on this computer in the training folder.
problems.TRAINING_NOT_CONFIGURED: Training is not set up in the host agent (kohya, model and training folders).
problems.TRAINING_BUSY: Another training run is in progress.
problems.TRAINING_INPUT_MISSING: The dataset or the base model file is missing.
problems.LORA_LIMIT: At most 2 LoRAs can be used together.
problems.SVG_TARGET_REQUIRED: Choose an asset, or a category and name for a new one.
problems.SVG_PARAM_INVALID: A template parameter is out of range.
problems.SVG_PARAM_UNKNOWN: The template has no such parameter.
problems.SVG_TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND: This SVG template does not exist.
problems.SVG_TEMPLATE_CHANGED: The template changed after queueing; create it again.
problems.PALETTE_MISMATCH: This colour is not in the style's palette.
